{{Top|leg}}
'''Arquas'Tais''' or "Land of Fallen Ones of Valor" was a vast cemetery located outside of [[Coyn]]'s capital city of [[En'Tra'Tal]]. An honor guard of four [[Coynite/Legends|Coynites]] in full battle regalia always watched over the field. All Coynites who fell in battle and members of other species who fought for Coyn or died in service to the [[Mercenary Guild of Coyn/Legends|Mercenary Guild of Coyn]] were buried here.
